  INFY | 500209 | INE009A01021 | 1594 | INFY | Infosys Ltd. | 630 | Equity | 32 | {} | Rapid Results | 100 | None | 1171.6 | -0.83 | 2026-10-23T10:46:50+00:00 | Q2FY27 Quarterly Result Announced for Infosys Ltd. | IT Consulting & Software company Infosys announced Q2FY27 results Standalone Financial Highlights:  Revenue from Operations: For Q2FY27, Standalone Revenue from Operations reached Rs 40,719 crore, representing a QoQ growth of 1.91% from Rs 39,957 crore in Q1FY27, and a YoY growth of 10.33% from Rs 36,907 crore in Q2FY26. For H1FY27, standalone revenue from operations stood at Rs 80,676 crore, displaying an increase of 11.77% YoY over Rs 72,182 crore in H1FY26. Total Income: Standalone Total Income was reported at Rs 42,421 crore in Q2FY27, indicating a QoQ expansion of 3.89% against Rs 40,831 crore in Q1FY27 and a YoY growth of 8.29% compared to Rs 39,175 crore in Q2FY26. For H1FY27, Standalone Total Income reached Rs 83,252 crore, which is a 10.51% YoY increase over Rs 75,333 crore in H1FY26. Profit Before Tax (PBT): For Q2FY27, Standalone PBT stood at Rs 10,905 crore, posting a sequential growth of 7.32% over Rs 10,161 crore in Q1FY27, and a YoY growth of 4.16% compared to Rs 10,469 crore in Q2FY26. For H1FY27, PBT increased by 10.13% YoY to Rs 21,067 crore against Rs 19,130 crore in H1FY26. Profit After Tax (PAT): Standalone PAT arrived at Rs 7,893 crore in Q2FY27, rising by 8.88% QoQ from Rs 7,249 crore in Q1FY27, and expanding by 1.73% YoY over Rs 7,759 crore in Q2FY26. For H1FY27, Standalone PAT grew 9.14% YoY to Rs 15,142 crore from Rs 13,874 crore in H1FY26. Earnings Per Share (EPS): Standalone Basic EPS stood at Rs 19.45 in Q2FY27, going up by 8.84% QoQ compared to Rs 17.87 in Q1FY27, and up by 4.12% YoY compared to Rs 18.68 in Q2FY26. For H1FY27, Basic EPS increased by 11.74% YoY to Rs 37.32 from Rs 33.40 in H1FY26.    Consolidated Financial Highlights:  Revenue from Operations: Consolidated Revenue from Operations was Rs 49,244 crore in Q2FY27, indicating a QoQ increase of 2.14% from Rs 48,211 crore in Q1FY27 and a YoY increase of 10.69% over Rs 44,490 crore in Q2FY26. For H1FY27, Consolidated Revenue from Operations expanded by 12.31% YoY to Rs 97,454 crore over Rs 86,769 crore in H1FY26. Total Income: Consolidated Total Income stood at Rs 50,092 crore in Q2FY27, indicating a QoQ uptick of 1.82% compared to Rs 49,195 crore in Q1FY27, and a YoY growth of 10.16% over Rs 45,472 crore in Q2FY26. For H1FY27, it reached Rs 99,286 crore, marking a YoY growth of 11.81% compared to Rs 88,793 crore in H1FY26. Profit Before Tax (PBT): For Q2FY27, Consolidated PBT came in at Rs 11,063 crore, rising sequentially by 0.32% over Rs 11,028 crore in Q1FY27, and up by 8.15% YoY over Rs 10,229 crore in Q2FY26. For H1FY27, Consolidated PBT arrived at Rs 22,091 crore, representing a 10.62% YoY growth from Rs 19,970 crore in H1FY26. Profit After Tax (PAT): Consolidated PAT reached Rs 7,838 crore in Q2FY27, expanding by 0.81% QoQ relative to Rs 7,775 crore in Q1FY27, and increasing by 6.28% YoY relative to Rs 7,375 crore in Q2FY26. For H1FY27, Consolidated PAT increased by 9.18% YoY to Rs 15,613 crore against Rs 14,300 crore in H1FY26. Earnings Per Share (EPS): Consolidated Basic EPS was Rs 19.32 in Q2FY27, ticking up by 0.68% QoQ from Rs 19.19 in Q1FY27, and showing a YoY growth of 8.78% from Rs 17.76 in Q2FY26. For H1FY27, Consolidated Basic EPS was reported at Rs 38.51, moving up by 11.72% YoY against Rs 34.47 in H1FY26.    Business & Segment Highlights:  Financial Services: This segment brought in the largest share of revenue at Rs 13,774 crore in Q2FY27 (compared to Rs 13,463 crore in Q1FY27 and Rs 12,320 crore in Q2FY26), with total half-yearly H1FY27 revenue at Rs 27,237 crore. Segment profit stood at Rs 3,644 crore for Q2FY27 and Rs 7,305 crore for H1FY27. Manufacturing: Segment revenue stood at Rs 7,913 crore in Q2FY27 (compared to Rs 7,668 crore in Q1FY27 and Rs 7,347 crore in Q2FY26), with total half-yearly H1FY27 revenue at Rs 15,581 crore. Segment profit was reported at Rs 1,694 crore for Q2FY27 and Rs 3,380 crore for H1FY27. Energy, Utilities, Resources and Services: This business generated a segment revenue of Rs 6,975 crore in Q2FY27 (compared to Rs 6,452 crore in Q1FY27 and Rs 5,945 crore in Q2FY26), with total half-yearly H1FY27 revenue at Rs 13,428 crore. Segment profit stood at Rs 1,986 crore for Q2FY27 and Rs 3,562 crore for H1FY27. Retail: Segment revenue was recorded at Rs 5,664 crore in Q2FY27 (compared to Rs 6,172 crore in Q1FY27 and Rs 5,639 crore in Q2FY26), with total half-yearly H1FY27 revenue at Rs 11,835 crore. Segment profit arrived at Rs 1,707 crore for Q2FY27 and Rs 3,408 crore for H1FY27. Communication: This segment registered a revenue of Rs 6,150 crore in Q2FY27 (compared to Rs 5,791 crore in Q1FY27 and Rs 5,397 crore in Q2FY26), with total half-yearly H1FY27 revenue at Rs 11,941 crore. Segment profit was Rs 1,146 crore for Q2FY27 and Rs 2,326 crore for H1FY27. Life Sciences: Segment revenue advanced significantly to Rs 4,145 crore in Q2FY27 (compared to Rs 3,842 crore in Q1FY27 and Rs 2,863 crore in Q2FY26), with total half-yearly H1FY27 revenue at Rs 7,986 crore. Segment profit came in at Rs 631 crore for Q2FY27 and Rs 1,250 crore for H1FY27. Hi-Tech: Revenue for this business stood at Rs 3,332 crore in Q2FY27 (compared to Rs 3,710 crore in Q1FY27 and Rs 3,703 crore in Q2FY26), with total half-yearly H1FY27 revenue at Rs 7,042 crore. Segment profit was Rs 795 crore for Q2FY27 and Rs 1,706 crore for H1FY27. All Other Segments: Reported a revenue of Rs 1,291 crore in Q2FY27 and Rs 2,404 crore in H1FY27, with segment profits standing at Rs 86 crore for Q2FY27 and Rs 162 crore for H1FY27. Large Deal Momentum: Large deal TCV reached USD 5.2 billion during Q2FY27, with net new wins accounting for 62% of the deal volume.  Salil Parekh, CEO & MD, said: “We had strong large deals of USD 5.2 billion, including a mega deal of over USD 2 billion, reinforcing our position as a trusted partner in the marketplace when clients embark on large and complex transformation programs. Our AI revenue was at 10.5% and grew 29% QoQ. As enterprises move to AI adoption at scale, the strong growth in AI revenues is a recognition of our differentiated market positioning and client confidence.” “We are advising some of the largest global enterprise on their AI strategy and continue to invest in deep domain and technology capabilities to bring new ideas and an integrated ecosystem to help businesses unlock AI value at scale.” Jayesh Sanghrajka, CFO, said: “We delivered operating margins of 21.0% in Q2 amidst heightened volatility. Focus on cost and operational efficiency measures while making the required investments, have led to stable margins.” “Free cash flow of $928 million, representing 113.3% of net profit, underscores the financial strength of the business. The Board has announced an interim dividend of Rs 26 per share, an increase of 13% from last year,” Result PDF | <h3><span style="font-size:16px;"><strong>IT Consulting & Software company Infosys announced Q2FY27 results</strong></span></h3>
